question: Choose the figure that is different from the others (Odd Man Out, Problem 14)
facts: All four are the same meander (zigzag) line. Options 1, 2 and 4 are rotations of one drawing. Option 3 is the mirror image of option 4 (they reflect each other), so it cannot be made by turning.
rel: When two figures look like reflections of each other, one of them is usually the odd one; test each against a third figure.

question: Which figure will look like figure (X) when seen in a mirror? (Analogy, Problem 28)
facts: A mirror flips left and right. The E-shape turns into a backwards E, and the black ball, which was on the left of the back line, moves to the right of the back line. That is option 1. Option 3 is also backwards but its ball sits at the end of the middle arm.
rel: In a mirror, top and bottom stay the same; only left and right swap. Track one small mark (like the ball).
